findings.current: he’d gone on to master the names of cows and horses, completing the trilogy of poop names.
findings.defect: “Names of cows and horses” makes the joke sound like animal naming rather than successive Cow Poop and Horse Poop identities.
findings.rationale: The cow and horse extend the sequence of names built on 똥, meaning “poop.”
findings.replacement: he’d tried Cow Poop and Horse Poop too, completing his trilogy of poop names.
findings.source: 소와 말까지 두루 섭렵하며 기어코 똥 시리즈 삼부작을 완성.

findings.current: “With that Myriad-Mile Pursuit Beggars’ Sect Leader dressed like the king of beggars, you’d think he was suffering from infirmities of old age, but he doesn’t look old enough for that yet… I can’t even begin to guess what part of the world that old mutt crawled out of.”
findings.defect: The draft attributes the ragged appearance and apparent age to the Beggars’ Sect Leader. Jeok is describing Great Sir; the leader is only a comparison.
findings.rationale: 그 왕초 거지 놈도 울고 갈 행색 describes Great Sir’s appearance as surpassing even the beggar leader’s; the following uncertainty concerns Great Sir’s identity.
findings.replacement: “Great Sir looks so ragged even Myriad-Mile Pursuit, that king of beggars, would weep, but he doesn’t seem old enough to be suffering from infirmities of old age… I can’t even guess where that stray mutt crawled out of.”
findings.source: “만리추행(萬里追行), 그 왕초 거지 놈도 울고 갈 행색을 하고 있어서 그렇지 아직 노환에 걸릴 나이는 아닌 것 같고…… 도대체 어디서 굴러먹다 온 개뼈다귀인지 감도 안 잡히는군.”

findings.current: You laughed at him last time, but it wasn’t so easy when you faced him yourself, was it?
findings.defect: “Him” makes Jin Taekyung the target of the Grand Mage’s earlier mockery. The Blood Lord is referring to her having mocked his own earlier encounter.
findings.rationale: The exchange contrasts her present near-failure with the Blood Lord’s earlier setback, which she had mocked.
findings.replacement: You mocked me last time, but it wasn’t so easy when you had to face him yourself, was it?
findings.source: 지난번에는 그렇게 비웃더니, 막상 직접 겪어 보니 쉽지 않지?

summary: Two dialogue passages change who is being described or mocked. The draft also obscures the poop-name joke and splits one System panel.
